import importlib.util
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('task181',p); mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
def make_grid(n,axis,mapping):
    g=[[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            x={'row':r,'down':r-c,'up':r+c}[axis]
            if x in mapping:g[r][c]=mapping[x]
    return g
cases=[
(15,'row',{3:1,4:9,5:2,10:9},4,[9,2,9,1]),
(25,'row',{12:6,13:1,15:9,20:5,22:9,23:3},6,[6,1,5,9,9,3]),
(24,'down',{-4:5,18:6,19:2,20:5,22:7},5,[5,5,6,7,2]),
(15,'row',{0:6,3:9,5:8,6:9,7:1,9:6,10:3,12:3},8,[6,6,3,9,3,8,9,1]),
(19,'up',{3:1,12:1,26:7,29:9},4,[1,9,7,1]),
(6,'up',{5:2,9:6,10:9},3,[6,9,2]),
]
results=[]
